note: Pixel measurements read from references/omega-speedmaster-calibre-321-31130403001001/omega-31130403001001_original.png (1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG, near-upright catalogue render, crown at 3 with two chronograph pushers at about +-25 deg, 3-column steel bracelet that runs off the image at 12 and 6 o'clock, round case flank without crown guards, straight lugs). ALL POSITIONS ARE CONTINUOUS PHOTO COORDINATES (pixel i spans [i, i+1]).
scale_basis: Case width 39.7 mm: the left case flank is a clean circle (fit over rows 330..600: centre (512.2, 460.9), r 281.2, residual 0.05 px; with the bezel centre (513.3) as centre r 282.4) -> 14.17 .. 14.23 px/mm; bracelet / lug gap 19 mm = 268 px (x 376 .. 644 at rows 132 .. 160) -> 14.1 px/mm; lug to lug (rows 134 .. 805.5 = 671.5 px) -> 47.3 mm at 14.2 (no published figure used). Adopted 14.2 (case 39.77 mm, lug to lug 47.5 mm as built, bracelet gap 18.9 mm).
pivot_basis: least-squares point of the three hand axes (hour 303.468 deg, minute 47.898 deg, seconds 221.828 deg; edge-midpoint line fits in rotated strips, thr 110, residuals 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.05 px); the hub circle (r 21.0) is centred there; bezel outer circle (513.30, 460.70) r 275.12 (ellipse axes 548.7 x 551.2 px, round within 0.5 percent).
bezel_out_circle_note: black bezel ring outer edge (dark ring to steel, 60-level crossing on 1 deg rays outside the crown / pusher sector, 162 points after outlier rejection, std 0.38 px); NOT the scale anchor. The steel case ring beyond it (about 7 px) and the case flank circle (centre 513.3, 460.7, r 281.6..282.0) are in the silhouette.
rings_note: median radial profiles over 80 deg of dial about the bezel centre: black dial to r 203.5, bright thin inner steel ring r 204.5 .. 211.5 (grey ~90), dark gap 212 .. 218 (grey 37), lighter inner chamfer r 219 .. 242 (grey ~88), black bezel top (numerals / ticks) r 244 .. 274.5, bright steel ring from 275.5. No steel coin ring: insert_out = bezel_out.
right_override_note: rows where the right alpha edge is a chronograph pusher (upper rows 301..374, lower 560..632) or the crown (419..514): replaced by the case flank circle (centre (513.3, 460.7), r 281.6, in 12-row chords); the 3D pushers and crown are added in the step. This case has no crown guards: the flank is the circle.
pushers_note: axis-aligned views (rotated about the measured origin) of the alpha silhouette: upper pusher (24.7 deg) top edge flat at t -27.7, bottom 36.2 -> 34.7, end face s 329; lower pusher (-25.7 deg) edges t -29.7 / +33.5 flat, end face s 335; origins are the point (513, 461) shifted across the axis to the pusher centre line
